Action Performed (L2):
We have analyzed the logs for the provided timestamp and observed that the session failed during the cable check with the error:
"code": 67, "msg": "ERR_EV_DROPPED, vehicle ended with unexpected pilot state B"
.
We informed the customer that the session was aborted by the vehicle; however, they do not agree with this explanation and saying that
“Charging Statemachine CCU is 40s in "CableCheck" - PLC statemachine BSW in cablecheck too - it looks like the cable check was not fullfilled - I could also see that during cable check there was never any voltage at VoltageDirectCurrentChargingInput - so it looks like no Voltage from Charging Station applied.”
